subject: Vet spot-check escalation: legacy user roster and training evidence
body:
From: Sara Milton <sara.milton@harborbank.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, alec.grant@harborbank.com
Date: Tue, 07 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vet spot-check: legacy user roster and evidence request

Jonas / team —

Thanks again for taking this on quickly. During our routine SIG spot-check we observed a small set of legacy user accounts that appear to have active permissions after their termination dates in HR. To close our finding we need the following artifacts for a random sample (we picked 8 accounts) and a brief remediation plan: 

- Redacted training roster entries showing completion dates for each sampled account (Q1 2026)
- Background check summary pages (redacted PII) for those accounts
- Offboarding log exports that include deprovisioning timestamps and who approved the removal
- Access revocation event exports for the relevant services (timestamps and operator)

Can you confirm receipt and provide ETA? We have an external audit window next week, so if you can get the sample to us by Thu 2026-04-09 EOD that would be ideal. If you need to widen the sample or have questions about format, flag it.

For context: the flagged accounts are from legacy AD sync before we introduced the current offboard webhook (implemented 2025-11). We just need evidence that you’ve identified and fixed any gaps, and that training records were in place.

Best,
Sara Milton
Senior Risk Analyst — HarborBank

-----Original Message-----
(quoted for thread continuity)

From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: Sara Milton <sara.milton@harborbank.com>
Subject: Re: Vet spot-check: legacy user roster and evidence request
Date: Tue, 07 Apr 2026 09:56:12 -0700

Sara — thanks for the heads up. I’ll coordinate internally and get you an initial packet.

Plan:
- I’ll own the response and assemble a sample packet for the 8 accounts you identified.
- Priyom (cc’d) will pull the offboard/export logs from the IAM system and the deprovision webhook traces.
- Kimberly will generate the redacted roster and BG summaries.

We’ll upload artifacts to a secured Drive folder and attach redacted CSV/PDFs in-line. If anything in the sample shows systemic issues we’ll open a remediation Jira (INF-1127) and provide timelines.

ETA: preliminary packet by Thu 2026-04-09 17:00 PT, full follow-up by Mon 2026-04-13. If you need earlier, let me know and we’ll prioritize.

Jonas Weber
Director, Trust & Safety
Redwood Inference

---
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: Sara Milton <sara.milton@harborbank.com>, Alec Grant <alec.grant@harborbank.com>
Date: Wed, 08 Apr 2026 11:24:33 -0700
Subject: Re: Vet spot-check: legacy user roster and evidence request

Jonas / Sara / Kimberly —

Attaching the items we have for the 8 sample accounts. Files attached here (redacted per PII guidance):
- training_roster_Q1_2026_redacted.csv (includes completion timestamps and training module IDs)
- bg_check_summary_redacted.pdf (one-page summary per user; names redacted; check dates included)
- offboard_log_exports_2025-2026.csv (filters applied for deprovision events)
- access_revocations_2026-04.json (system events for the sample accounts; operator IDs masked)

Notes: 
- Two accounts show offboard logs where the deprovision webhook fired but the downstream service did not process the event within 24 hours (we’ve marked those in the CSV). We have already initiated a remediation (JIRA INF-1127) to add a retry + alert when webhook delivery latency exceeds 5 minutes.
- BG check dates for contractor ID C-441 are missing a timestamp in our HR export — we are pulling the source from our background vendor and will attach by EOD tomorrow.

I’ve uploaded everything to a restricted Drive folder and set view-only links for HarborBank. Link included below.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBexAMPLEdrivelink
Jira: INF-1127 (remediation for webhook delivery retries)
HubSpot: HubSpot-Deal-654321 (for audit trace)

Priyom Das
Security Operations Engineer
Redwood Inference

---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 08 Apr 2026 08:47:02 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Vet spot-check: legacy user roster and evidence request

Priyom — attaching the redacted rosters and BG summaries I pulled this morning. I scrubbed PII per our compliance checklist and included a mapping file for the sample IDs. Two items outstanding: contractor C-441 BG timestamp and one legacy admin account that shows I-9 partial in the HR system — I flagged both in the manifest.

Attachments: training_roster_Q1_2026_redacted.csv, bg_check_summary_redacted.pdf

Kimberly Park
HR Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

---
From: Sara Milton <sara.milton@harborbank.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: alec.grant@harborbank.com
Date: Thu, 09 Apr 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vet spot-check: legacy user roster and evidence request

Jonas / team —

Thanks — we received the Drive link and the attached CSV/PDFs. The packet looks mostly complete and the remediation plan (INF-1127) is acceptable. One quick clarification before we close the sample:

- For contractor C-441, can you confirm the vendor-provided BG check completion date (we only see the pre-hire date in our copy)? If the BG finished after termination, we’ll need the date and a short note on whether their access was ever active post-termination.

If you can confirm C-441’s BG completion date by Mon 2026-04-12, we’ll mark this sample as closed pending that item. Appreciate the fast turnaround and the remediation ticket.

Best regards,
Sara Milton
Senior Risk Analyst — HarborBank
